scripts.preinstall:
case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) printf '
  This repo installs with pnpm only (engines.pnpm). Run: pnpm install

' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
scripts.//test-db: Needs a migrated crm_test: pnpm dev:db:start && pnpm dev:db:migrate:test
scripts.//db-compose: Local Postgres. --wait blocks on compose.yml's healthcheck, so the next script in a chain can assume a server that accepts connections.
scripts.//dev-db-reset: Destroys the volume, which is what re-runs docker/postgres/init (crm_test) — nothing else does.
scripts.dev:db:reset: docker compose -f docker/compose.yml down -v && pnpm dev:db:start && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm dev:db:migrate:test && pnpm dev:db:seed
scripts.//db-migrate-test: Sources the root .env.test, the single definition of the test database. Exported vars beat dotenv, which does not override an existing process.env.
scripts.clean:all: pnpm run clean && rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules
